home.title: Fish the Maldives
home.lead: Elite sports fishing charters & private tours. From heart-pounding GT popping to traditional Maldivian handlining, experience the Indian Ocean like never before.
home.toursLead: Every trip is private and tailored to your group — whether you are chasing a record GT or a relaxed catch-and-cook dinner under the stars.

about.title: Local captains.
about.lead: Veyru Keyolhu is a small, locally run fishing charter in the Maldives.
about.body:
Our crew grew up on these reefs, learning the currents, tides and fishing spots the way Maldivians have for generations. Today we share that with visitors — from first-timers trying a handline under the stars to experienced anglers chasing a Giant Trevally.

Every trip is private, so we can go at your pace and fish the way you want. All gear is included, safety equipment is on every boat, and sport species like GT are always released.

staying.title: Rest between
staying.lead: A little more island time. Simple, comfortable places to stay between days on the water — ask us about current availability.

contact.title: Let’s go
contact.lead: Message us with your preferred date, trip and group size — we usually reply within a few hours.

tours.title: Traditional Maldivian Night Fishing
tours.short: Handlines, starlight and a catch-and-cook dinner — fishing the way Maldivians have for centuries.
tours.intro: Experience fishing the way Maldivians have for centuries. We use the simplest, most effective method: a handline and a piece of bait.
tours.thrill: Feeling the nibble directly on your fingers while the boat drifts under a starlit sky. It is peaceful, rhythmic, and highly productive.
tours.targets: Red Snapper, Jobfish, Sea Bass, Jackfish
tours.bestFor: Families, couples, and anyone who wants a “Catch & Cook” dinner

tours.title: Big Game Trolling
tours.short: Lines out behind the boat in open ocean, waiting for the reel to scream.
tours.intro: Head beyond the atoll into deep blue water where pelagic predators hunt. We run a spread of lures behind the boat while cruising the edges and FADs where big fish gather.
tours.thrill: The sudden scream of the reel as a tuna, wahoo or sailfish hits — then the fight to bring it alongside.
tours.targets: Yellowfin Tuna, Skipjack, Wahoo, Mahi-Mahi, Sailfish, Marlin
tours.equipment: Heavy trolling rods & reels, skirted lures
tours.bestFor: Groups and anglers wanting big fish with no casting skill needed

tours.title: Top-Water Popping & Casting
tours.short: Cast poppers over the reef edge and watch a Giant Trevally explode on the surface.
tours.intro: The Maldives is one of the world's best destinations for GT popping. We cast large surface lures along channel mouths and reef drop-offs where Giant Trevally patrol.
tours.thrill: Watching a GT charge your popper and smash it on the surface — the most visual strike in sport fishing.
tours.targets: Giant Trevally (GT), Bluefin Trevally, Grouper, Bohar Snapper
tours.equipment: Heavy spinning rods, PE 6–8 braid, poppers & stickbaits
tours.bestFor: Experienced anglers and thrill-seekers ready for a workout
tours.note: GT are catch-and-release to protect the fishery.

tours.title: Vertical Jigging (Deep Sea)
tours.short: Drop metal jigs to 100m+ and work them up through the water column.
tours.intro: We position the boat over deep reef slopes and pinnacles (thilas), then drop heavy metal jigs to the bottom. A fast, rhythmic retrieve triggers strikes from powerful deep-water species.
tours.thrill: Hooking something unknown in the deep and feeling it pull hard all the way to the surface.
tours.targets: Dogtooth Tuna, Amberjack, Grouper, Job Fish, Rainbow Runner
tours.bestFor: Anglers wanting a physical challenge and a variety of species

tours.title: Light Tackle & Reef Casting
tours.short: Light rods, crystal-clear shallows and non-stop action from colourful reef fish.
tours.intro: A relaxed trip around the inner reefs and lagoons with light spinning gear. Cast small lures and soft plastics over coral gardens where there's action on almost every cast.
tours.thrill: Constant bites from colourful reef species — and the chance of a surprise bigger fish.
tours.targets: Bluefin Trevally, Snapper, Emperor, Grouper, Barracuda
tours.equipment: Light spinning rods, small lures & soft plastics
tours.bestFor: Beginners, kids, and anyone who wants plenty of fish with little effort
